batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b M Morkel

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c BJ Rohrer b IK Pathan

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b S Nadeem

batting.name: DB Das
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b A Nehra

batting.name: S Narwal
batting.dismissal: c UBT Chand b UT Yadav

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b L Balaji

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b JH Kallis

batting.name: UBT Chand
batting.dismissal: c L Balaji b B Lee

balls.text: fuller on the off stump this time, hit well again and it needs a scrambling effort from the fielder at long-off to stop it, a couple of runs for Lee
another one, another six, Lee's turning it on here with the bat and he's pushed the side into the 130s now, fuller on the middle stump and that's a golfing swing, a tee off to get a six!
very full and outside the off stump, tries to crash it through the point region, misses

shot, shot! good shot, he gives himself some room, opens his stance up and goes for a pull, almost like he was expecting it to be short and he gets what he wanted, pulls it away for a six! the umpire gives it four but the decision is changed and given a six!
slower one outside the off and he is able to tap it towards long-off, the fielder at extra-cover comes across and fields it before which they get a single
drilled down the ground, it was fuller and he goes for a drive, hits well too but straight to long-off
short of length again but this time he adjusts his stroke and gets it through the point region for a four, gets himself to 25 from as many
slower bouncer and completely defeats the stroke, 112 km/hr, he was looking to pull it away but misses
slower one now and Lee pushes it to the off side for a single to open his account
short and very quick, he was looking to pull it and the ball come rather quickly on to him, beats his stroke and he gloves it to fine-leg

and finally it's over, good knock ends, caught at long-on he was looking to slog it over the leg-side but gets a bit of a sliced shot there and it goes high and to the fielder at long-on, well taken by Chand
wow, what a shot, it's bowled rather full outside the off, he tries to get his bat out in an attempt to scoop it over the point fielder and does that well, through over the fielder
short of length and defended off the back foot, pushed to the covers and they are away for a very quickly taken single
poor delivery outside the off stump, full toss and well wide outside, does not get any bat on it and given a wide
too quick and too much bounce for the number eight batsman, he was looking to give himself room and cut it away, misses
short of length ball and he wants to pull it away, gets it away to mid-wicket
much fuller this time and the batsman is able to drive it through to wide long-off, they get a single and are able to come back, Nadeem has to rush around from long-off to get to the ball
on a length and he is beaten outside the off stump, was looking to open the face of the bat
outside the off stump, he was looking to across outside the off stump and wanted to flick it, he bowls it very full and further outside, misses
too short from Yadav and he continues to play that slap-pull stroke, gets it out to the deep square-leg for a single
on his pads and quietly flicked away through the fine-leg region, Morkel was at the fine-leg and he fails to stop it, gives chase but Warner has to come around and tidy up again
on his pads and flicked away to the backward square-leg region, Warner runs across from the deep square-leg and gets to the ball, fields and throws well but the batsmen are back for the second
and this is outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat, pushed to the off side for a single
another short ball, a very, very poor delivery and he's pulled it over mid-wicket this time, but the result isn't different, four!
thumped him over the bowler for a four, that's an excellent shot, length ball and Narwal has almost chopped it over the bowler and to the fence
short of length outside the off and he pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs
short of length and he goes for a pull, it was a shot played almost in a slow-mo and the top-edge goes over the keeper and for a four
on a good length from over the wicket, he pushes out and gets an outside edge through to the third-man region for a single
shorter in length and he is on his back foot, opens the face of the bat, runs it to third-man for a single
edged and taken! Nehra's got Das! short of length and he wanted to pull it away, the ball gets a lot of bounce on it and it only gets a top edge that flies off to the keeper, easily taken
on the middle stump and fuller, pushed into the off side, hits the middle of the bat but not in the gap
down the leg-side and he lets it go through to the keeper, wide called
shot on the up, it was on the off stump and not quite full enough, he goes through with the shot, hits it through the line and over mid-off for a boundary
bit of an outside edge that flies away to the off side for a couple of runs
whoa, what a delivery, it seems like it's hit the stumps and not dislodged the bails, a big thwack onto the stumps and it's not gone down in a hurry! beats the outside edge there...
short of length, almost a bouncer and he was looking to half-pull and almost defend off the last moment, does not get near doing either and it goes through to the keeper
shorter in length and the batsman can only push it into the point area, is sent back by the non-striker
fuller on the leg stump and flicked away to deep mid-wicket, it's Warner who's quickly on to the ball and they decide against the second
pushed into the covers and they are off for a single
down the ground and smacked over the bowler's head, hits the sight-screen on the full to earn him a six
swept away to the deep square-leg region for a single
shorter in length and he pulls it down the ground to long-on for a single
shorter in length and he cuts it away through to deep point for a single
quicker on his pads and hit to the leg side, rolls over for a single
in-swinger and he was looking to play it off the back foot, hits his pads and no chance for a single, ends an excellent spell of four overs from Pathan
shortens his length and it's outside the off stump, pushed into the covers for a single
bouncer attempted this time but too high for the batsman and called a wide

whoa another possible run-out, that was hit straight to the fielder at backward point, Rohrer rushes in and tries to break the stumps but misses, Das also dived in but would have been quite close had it hit
shorter in length and easily pushed it through the covers for a single
outside the off and on a good length, 123 km/hr, pushes it to the off side for a single
wants to swing it away, looked like a shorter ball but was a slower one too and the bat's away far too quickly, beats the outside edge
down the track and smashes it through the bowler's hand for a four, it was absolutely powered and the bowler had no time to react to that
and now slows it down and pushes it on to his pads, tapped to the leg side for a single
frustration gets the better of him, looks to go down and hit it over the off side, gets an outside edge but luckily does not go to a fielder on the full
was looking to go down the track but it comes in quicker and he has to push his bat down in time
slows it down and the ball grips a tad, spins away, defended again
down the leg side, he was looking to flick it away, misses, hits his pads
whoa, what bounce, outside the off and he was looking to cut it but that was quick and off a good length it flies away through the keeper with the batsman left without any edge on it
shorter in length yet again, not giving him too much to drive and he's left with patting it to the off side
and another one on the off stump, pushed it to the off side for a quick one, Warner rushes in and gets the stumps down again, it ricochets off it again and for an overthrow
on his pads and wants to flick it away but it's got some bounce there, hits his pads and they are away for a single
shorter in length and he is pushed on to the back foot, defended to the covers
on a good length and he pats it to the off side, they are off for a quick single, the fielder gets in quickly and throws the stumps down at the non-striker's end, direct hit again!
on his pads and he wants to force it away, hits his pads and rolls over to the leg side to end an excellent maiden over
and now it's five dots as he defends to the off side
wants to play it to the leg side but gets an inside edge to his pads
that one turns away from the bat, only defended to the off side again
another one on the off stump and pushed to short cover
on a length outside the off off stump, pushed to the off side
fuller, 128.7 km/hr, pushed to the short cover fielder but not for runs
shorter from the bowler this time and he opens the face of the bat pushes it to the point region
and that's almost played one, it swung back in and the defensive stroke almost sneaks through

gone now, Kallis is out this time, fifth wicket down and that's another ripper! it was outside the off stump and he tries to slice it over the point, Rohrer has to jump up and take it. He does exactly does and needs only one hand to grab it!
swing back into the batsman, tucked away to the leg side for a single
and that one jumps up disconcertingly on the batsman, short of length and he wanted to cut it, gets a tad too high on him
short of length, cut away to the point fielder, and they are away for a quick one, close call had that direct hit taken the stumps
spins away from the batsman this time, beats the outside edge

and now on the leg side but hes caught! he was trying to pull it away that time but he hits it too well, and hits it straight to Yadav, well not quite straight to him, but in his general direction and he moves around to the right and takes a good catch, four down
reverse sweeps and for a four, it was pitched outside the leg-stump and he has taken it from there to hit it away to the deep cover region
on his pads and tapped away to the leg side for a single
on his pads from round the stumps, pushes it into the square-leg region for a single
opens the face of the bat and guides it through to the deep cover fielder
defended off the back foot and to the off side, fielded at short cover
tipped it over the mid-wicket fielder for a four, it was on to his pads and he jumps down and gets it over the in-field and to the fence
on a length and this one keeps low, defended to the left of the bowler, fielded by Pathan too
and another one that swings away from the batsman, he lets it go through to the keeper
swing away from the bat, the left-hander was walking down the track and is beaten, outside edge missed
short of length and Kallis defends it from the back foot, pushes to the point region

and that's gone very high, and tell you what, Pathan's caught Pathan! again the swing of the bat, but this time it does not come off the middle, and the edge of the bat means that it's gone high, in fact very high, takes a lot of time to come down which means that Irfan has to account for a bit of swirl too and he manages to take it, well caught!
full swing of the bat but this is the ball to hit them, it was fuller and on the middle stump, swings it over long-on for a max!
shortens his length and he defends it to the off side, wanted the single too but is sent back
short of length and pulled away over the in-field, gets high on the bat but is powerful enough to get it over and for a couple
swings at it against Morne Morkel and misses it by a mile, this was swinging away from the batsman and he does not give himself any time to have a look at him
well bowled from Yadav there, he's getting them on a good length and off pace, getting them to swing back in, he taps it to the off side this time
short, wide and he lets it go through to the keeper this time, does not go after it Kallis
bit of a jag back into the batsman and he gets pegged back a tad, defended off the back foot
superb shot from Kallis that, it was short of length and he half-pulls, half-flicks it to fine-leg to the fence, very well done
down the leg side now and it's drifting further down, Kallis wanted to hit that away too but far too wide for him to get any bat on it
outside the off but a lot fuller, lets that one go through to the keeper
short, wide and cut away through the point region for a four, Kallis has finally succeeded in getting the ball in the area where he wants them
what happened there, he was looking to almost paddle sweep Nehra over short fine-leg but it hits him, well bowled that from the bowler
beaten, outside the off stump and moving away, Pathan was looking to push his bat at it, misses the outside edge
and another edge, Kallis has definitely come out with a need to score quick and goes for another drive, gets the outside half of the bat that rushes to the fine third-man fielder
outside the off and Kallis looks to be in a hurry, at least in shot-making, again tries to drive it through the covers, gets an inside edge through to mid-on
was looking to walk across the stumps and Nehra gets it in slightly shorter, tapped away to the leg side
edged and flies through to third-man for a single, short of length outside the off and he was looking to punch it on the up, gets the edge
on the off stump and quick, he defends it well to the off side, into the covers
short of length and he wanted to cut it away, gets the toe-end of the bat and it's run away to the third-man region for a single
fuller and driven down to mid-off, straight to the fielder
what a ripper! that's absolutely unplayable from the bowler, it was pitching on the middle and looked like angling it, but it swings away from the batsman and at some pace there!

gone this time, Bisla's gone, bowled and KKR are in early trouble! it was pitched up and the batsman was looking to hit it over the bowler's head, misses the shot and the ball sneaks through, beaten, bowled and they are two down.
what a delivery, pitching marginally outside the off and swinging away from the batsman, beats the bat
wide ball, swinging wider away from the batsman and he was looking to get some bat on it, fails to get any touch
on the middle stump now and Pathan gets some bat on it, defended to the leg side but Nehra is quickly off to field that to his right
and beaten this time! pitched on a good length and on the middle stump, it swings away from the batsman at pace and misses the outside edge
and that's swung away from the bat, beats the outside edge of the bat

punched, slapped, smashed, that was short of length and Pathan powers it back, it hots the bowler and changes direction, the mid-on fielder was moving to his left before he had to rush off to his right, no chance of getting close to it
on his pads and that's easily glanced away through the leg side for a four, easily beats the man at short fine-leg and it races away
hoicked away by Yusuf Pathan over mid-wicket but it does go off the middle of the bat, flies away, three runs because the ball stops before it gets there
fuller this time and on the off stump, defended off the front foot to the off side
outside the off with a hint of a swing back into the batsman, pushed into the covers
and wow, first ball he walks down the pitch and slaps it over to fine-leg, goes on a bounce to the fielder, single

gone, run-out, suicidal this, how could he do that! gone without facing a ball here, it hits his pads and they wanted a single, Gambhir seemed to have responded quickly enough but Pathan was quick to get to it, runs across and throws down the stumps at the striker's end, third-umpire was called upon to adjudicate and he has no hesitation in giving that out
short of length and pulled away to the fence for a four! that was casually lofted over the in-field and it rushes away!
and he laps it to fine-leg for a single, gets it away to notch up their third win!
what a shot! he pulls it like it was an after-thought, it was a short alright but he does not go for it till very late, gets it off the middle and smack, goes for a six
on his pads and short enough to pull it away, he does exactly that and it runs away to deep square-leg for a single
quicker and angling in from round the stumps, tapped to the off side
short from Pathan and easily played it through the backward point, they get an easy two and tell you what, they want to come back for the third and they do that!
very short again and Warner hooks it away to the fence, through fine-leg and not a chance for the fielder there given how fine it went

top-edge and that's caught, stop the press I tell you! it was short of length and Chand was looking to hook it away, it was wide outside the off stump and that made the shot difficult, it takes the edge and goes high, not too far and Balaji gets under it takes it well
shorter in length and pulled it away to the deep square-leg for a single
slapped and for a six! that's a good definition of opening one's shoulders, it was wide and it was on a length, he slams it over long-off for a six!
outside the off stump and wants to open the face of the bat through to third-man, gets bit of an inside edge, still goes through to third-man
on the middle stump and defended off the back foot, to the right of the bowler
and now it's over the mid-wicket region, Bhatia gets his hand to it but fails to latch on to it, a night of what-ifs for Kolkata
opens the face of the bat and guides it to Narwal at third-man for a single
down the track, and that's dropped again! Third miss of the night, second drop of the evening and the slash shot from Chand goes straight to hands at third-man, missed by Narwal
tapped to the off side and they are off for a quick one, Bisla seems to have collided with Chand, and he's down for the count.
is this the shot of the game? certainly one of the best, shortish in length and a gently flick of the wrist gets away to the deep square-leg region fro a four, 50 for Warner too!
slow bouncer from Balaji and easily thumped away through mid-wicket for a four, easily played away
he's not pitching them up too much here and Warner is easily able to cut it away through the backward point region, luckily Kallis gets his dive in time and restricts them to a single
fullish on his pads and he works it away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length, short enough and slow enough to tap it in front of square for a single
opens the face of the bat and guides it to short point, again not for runs
shorter in length he wants to cut it but does not get it away off the middle
swept away and there is a misfield at backward square-leg from Kallis, not having a great day is the great man
short of length, on the back foot, tucked away to the leg side for a single
what a shot from Chand, he was first looking to duck under the bouncer but at the very last moment he plays the upper cut, gets it over the keeper and to the fence
cracks it like how he likes to, after all those deft placements he manages to crack it away through the deep point region for a single
on a good length and tucked away to the leg side for a single
short of length and on the middle stump, defended off the back foot, to the leg side
strays on the pads and that's beautifully played through the short fine-leg region for a four! it was neatly tucked away and beats the fielder
fuller on the leg stump and works it away between deep square-leg and deep mid-wicket, it's not hit hard and they are able to come back for the second
shorter in length and defended off the back foot, back to the bowler, they are playing Narine well now
prodigious turn and a lot of bounce, opens the face of the bat and gets it to the backward point fielder
shorter on length and Warner's played the most delicate of shots to earn himself a four, he has opened the face of the bat and guided it through point to the fence, not hit too hard
fuller from Narine and driven down the ground for a single
quicker, on the off stump and slight turn away from the batsman, pushed back

dropped, Warner's missed yet again and this time it's Kallis at long-on! he was looking to slog it over long-on but does not get it off the middle of the bat, gets to Kallis and he fluffs his lines, also parries it over the fence!
cleanly punched and over the bowler's head, for a couple! it was a slower one and he pushed it back, not going through with his shot and still manages to get some timing on it
fuller from Bhatia, quicker too and driven down to long-on for a single
swept away and gets a couple of runs to backward square-leg, again it had no pace on it and it seemed like he was playing him like a leg spinner
slower one, a leg-spinner in fact and it's pulled over the mid-wicket region for a four, well read and equally well played
Bhatia continues to pitch it up to the bat and defended to the leg side by Chand
fuller on the middle stump and driven to wide mid-off for a single
he does not want to pitch it up and Warner is able to open the face of the bat and guides it through the point region for a single
and again, very short from Balaji, pulled away easily to the deep square-leg for a couple of runs
shorter in length and this one bounces on to the batsman, who opens the face of the bat, runs it through to the third-man for a single
slow ball, shorter ball and pulled across to deep square-leg for a single
and fuller on his pads with a short mid-wicket in place this time, it's hit in the air but eludes that fielder easily for a single

missed, stumping chance! it was an off-spinner from Bhatia and Warner had advanced down the track, misses his outside edge and should have been easily stumped, Bisla gets it on his gloved but fails to collect it cleanly, second miss from the KKR
slower from Bhatia, he opens the face of the bat and guides it through third-man for a four, the fielder was within the circle and easily beat him
and nothing different from the previous one, shorter in length and punched to the point fielder
shorter in length and punched to the point fielder, straight to him and not for runs
and that one just does not come on to the bat, Warner was almost an hour too early into the stroke and needed to quickly adjust to the pull, the mistimed shot helps him get back for the second
outside the off stump and it seemed to have held up, Warner was only able to push it to point
and that one comes in, Chand manages to get something on it, rolls over to the leg-side to end an excellent over from Narine, just one off
whoa, Chand's not reading them, not at all, it was on the off stump and it goes away from the bat, beaten
off the back foot, he pushes at the leggie from Narine, into the covers
turns back into the batsman, he was defending off the front foot, beats the bat, hits the pads, loud appeal but not-out given
quick leggie, it was short of length too and the batsman was looking to play off the back foot, beaten
shorter and outside the off, tapped away to the deep point region for a single
on the off stump and he look to run it down to the off side, gets it away to point
on the off stump and pushed to wide mid-off for a single
bouncer! pull! six! what a shot! it was a deliberately bowled bouncer and Warner was no looking to duck, he was looking to attack and that's exactly what he does, six over deep square-leg
again in the air to one on his pads, flicked it away to deep square-leg for a single
this is closer to the pads and it's flicked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs, was in the air for a bit but no fielder in that region
fuller from Kallis and Warner swings across to get it away to mid-on where it is fielded by Narine, restricts them to a single
on his pads and tucked away to wide mid-on for a single, a good comeback over from Lee
slower from Lee and the batsman opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single, finally gets off strike
short of length and pushed into the point region, but to Morgan at the fielder
bad shot, but is lucky to survive! he was looking to  pull it away and pace defeats him, it was a top-edge that goes flying and over the keeper's head, eludes all the players converging on it
shorter in length and outside the off stump, punches it rather well but to the fielder at point, Morgan has to dive to his right
short of length and he is on to the back foot, defended to the off side
and this time he does square him up, was looking to play it through the leg side but the batsman wasn't sure whether the ball would turn or, gets the leading edge to short third-man
fuller and driven down to long-on for a single, well played that from Chand
slightly shorter in length and he goes back, taps it back down to mid-off for a single
on the off stump now, bit of turn away, tapped to the off side
some slow turn from outside the leg stump, he was almost squared up there
on the pads, tucks it to the leg side but straight to the fielder
poor shot from Chand, it was on a length and without getting his foot out, he tries to drive at it, misses the outside edge
on a length and angling back into the batsman, tries to work it towards the leg side, to the fielder
and now opens the face of the bat and guides it through to wide third-man for a single, wanted the second but fielded well
slightly further wider outside the off and Warner is able to drive it through the wide mid-off region for a four, not your typical hard-hit strokes, more of a well-placed one
fuller outside the off and punched to the mid-off fielder, not for runs
edged and gone again, it is a very similar looking dismissal, he was looking to drive it this time and the edge carries through to the lone slip in place, Kallis catches it well to push them back
shot, drilled through the covers for a four, he bowled a bouncer last ball but this time he pitches it right up the bat and Chand is ready for it, times it through for a four
quick bouncer and Chand has to go down under it quickly enough, well bowler and reasonably well left

edged and taken, that's number one for KKR! it was on a length and he opens the face of the bat and guides it through to Pathan at the first slip, the ball pops out yet again but manages to hold on to it in the end
on the middle stump and off a good length, tucked away to the mid-wicket region, straight to the fielder
and now goes to slash it away, misses the outside edge of the bat and through to the keeper
fuller and caresses it through point for a four, beats a diving Eoin Morgan and it goes all the way, good, good shot!
and again, likes to open the face of the bat and run it through to third-man for a single
opens the face of the bat and it runs through to third-man for single
wow, Gambhir's dropped a sitter! it was hit on the up and the captain had kept himself there for that shot, goes straight to him and it pops out!
flicked over the top for a four, too leg-sidish from Lee and that does not allow the ball to swing too much, easily picked up and hit over the in-field for a boundary
length ball outside the off stump and he tries to thread it through the point region, straight to Morgan
slower from Lee this time, on the off stump and Sehwag pushes it to the point region
on the middle stump and tucked away to the leg side for a single

attempts a bouncer and at his pace he's not going to ruffle too many, Sehwag was looking to duck under for a while before realising the lack of pace and he goes for the pull, gets it fine and for a four!
fuller on the pads and flicked to wide mid-on for a single
he walks out now and wanted to flick it over the leg-side, manages to get it high but not long enough and they are back for the second to fine-leg
inside edge was it? because if it wasn't it looked as out as out can be, it was angling into the batsman and he missed, hits the pads

opens the face of the bat and runs it down to the fine third-man region for a single, it was running away to the fence but Lee runs across and fields rather well, dives around to prevent it from going away
on a good length and on a middle stump line, MJ has his bottom hand away while trying to tuck it to the leg side, not for runs
fuller on his pads and clipped away to wide mid-on, the fielder picks up and throws it down to the non-striker's end, misses
short of length from Lee and Sehwag is pegged to his back foot, tapped to the off side
ooh, almost, he was looking to have a waft at it, beats the inside edge of the bat and goes through to the keeper
on the middle stump for a change but this one does not swing any place, MJ taps it to the leg side and away for the first run off the bat
and another one that swing away, quick and swinging away, beats the outside edge of the bat, the ump thinks its wide enough to be called on
on a length and that swings away from the bat, a lot of movement but not close enough to make him play, lets it go through to the keeper
